answer.summary: The change routes three JsonFactory byte-based parser constructions through makeChildOrPlaceholder and adds isCanonicalizing() guards before _symbols.addName so that a placeholder table (which throws on addName) is never written to. Existing coverage of the placeholder contract is limited to PlaceholderSymbolTableTest and TestSymbolTables; async/DataInput tests use default features and won't hit the new branch. Key review points: the two new guards are the only addName sites in those parsers, and the behavior diverges from the unchanged UTF8StreamJsonParser/ByteSourceJsonBootstrapper path which instead falls back to ReaderBasedJsonParser.
